## Summary

Vellum Press Inc: theft from a locked locker of a laptop and docking station at a co-working space on Fenwick Street. Covered under clause 4.2; reserve 4,030 dollars.

## Facts

Vellum Press Inc reported the loss on 5 June 2026 under policy CC-1370 [notice of loss]. The loss occurred at a co-working space on Fenwick Street [notice of loss]. The items are a laptop and a docking station [invoice 1], [invoice 2]. The theft was reported to the police on 7 June 2026, reference CR/2026/4130 [police report]. The items were in a locked container at the time [police report]. The file does not state the date on which the theft took place.

## Coverage analysis

The loss falls under clause 4.2 of the policy, which covers loss of or damage to business contents at any premises while in the insured's custody, caused by theft [policy]. Exclusion 7.1 does not apply: the items were in a locked container [police report], [policy]. Exclusion 7.5 does not apply on the file: the police report is dated 7 June 2026, two days after the notice of loss dated 5 June 2026, so the report was made within seven days [police report], [notice of loss], [policy]. The exact date of the theft is not in the file and should be added for completeness. Exclusion 7.3 does not apply: the loss is a theft, not gradual deterioration [notice of loss], [policy]. Clauses 4.5, 4.7 and 4.9 are not engaged: the loss is not transit damage, escape of water or an electrical surge [notice of loss], [policy].

## Decision

Covered under clause 4.2. The claim is accepted.

## Reserve

The reserve is 4,030 dollars, the sum of the two invoices (2,370 dollars and 1,660 dollars) [invoice 1], [invoice 2]. The policy extract in the file contains no schedule showing an excess, and under clause 9.1 none applies where the schedule shows none, so no deduction is made [policy].
